findings.summary: Commit d2cedc3 fixes both major findings from review 1, and I confirmed each fix against the accepted 07-A service source. First, a replay's play now joins the server's play list only after service.start returns a receipt that was written to the database, whether that receipt is confirmed or still pending. A Replay whose Start fails before anything is saved (play-service.mjs:280) no longer causes a false 403 on later opens. Second, when Resume finds a stored pending save, Open now calls service.reconcile, which tries the journal write again (confirm, play-service.mjs:215-243). If the journal is still down it returns pending rather than failing outright. So a fresh client can recover after the in-memory retry is lost, and the fixture's journal health returns to healthy. The minor finding (unsupported acknowledgement) and the nit (extra Start/Resume step) are also handled. The controller's evidence on the reviewed tree: 56/56 tests passed, including new real HTTP/PGlite/journal regressions for each fixed path. The build passed. check_application_card passed. Browser automation (CUA) on d2cedc3 passed with the exact source blobs recorded. It covered phone layout, keyboard, a real save, pending/retry, recovery in a fresh tab, refresh restoring the exact revision, Replay opening at the introduction with older plays kept, closed access, and help/audio without autoplay. Every card criterion is met and the earlier browser findings are resolved. The only remaining problems are stale statements in the report.

It quotes 47 tests and spends a paragraph on the superseded httpCalls>8 probe failure. The controller's evidence for d2cedc3 shows 56/56 tests, a passing build, a passing card check and a passing CUA. The card's handoff asks for a record of actual exact revisions, checks and unresolved issues. A reader who looks only at the report would get the wrong evidence status.
findings.fix_check: When finalizing, the controller should update the report or append a section. It should give the reviewed commit d2cedc3, the actual exit statuses (56 tests, build, card check), the CUA evidence hash and source blobs, and the unresolved gates. Stale 'NOT YET RUN' rows should be marked as superseded.

findings.title: Opening a pending play reconciles every pending play in history
findings.problem: The history loop in full() calls current(), which calls service.reconcile and so attempts a journal write for every pending play in the list on each open. This is allowed: reconcile re-checks current authorization and only finishes the original stored command. But an open request now has side effects on plays the user did not select. This is not documented beyond the 'History reads can reconcile' sentence.
findings.fix_check: Either accept this as documented behaviour, or limit reconcile to the selected play and show other pending plays as trial_count:null.
